name: What is an asset?
description: The starter demonstration: what an asset@1 is and where to swap one, told in four steps on the console's Settings → Appearance. Generate your own from any glossary entry.
author: AmberX AXF

steps.title: Asset
steps.say: Everything you see in an AmberX app is an asset: a theme, a layout, a menu, a toolbar, a button, a slider, a dialog. Each one is a small JSON file in one shared format, asset@1.

steps.title: Appearance
steps.say: Settings, then Appearance, is where the active asset of every type is picked. Each row is one slot, like Color theme or Toolbar.

steps.title: Hot swap
steps.say: Pick another asset in any slot and the app restyles itself at once, with no reload. That is a hot swap: the engines compile the asset into tokens and the UI only reads tokens.

steps.title: Everywhere
steps.say: Because the look comes from axHub, the same swap reaches every app on the framework. One change, every app.
